method: Actual PNG viewed in the independent child context; complete actual submitted sidecar prompt/history and batch source contracts compared with current source template/handlers and matching real baseline where available. No generation or product runtime tests.
fieldActionRoleStateChecks: Actually viewed five rows/full submitted prompt and manifest contracts. Real error renderer retains retry/reread/download draft, not overwrite/force; complete last saved preview remains. Source/reference mismatch exact message matches session rejection.

Recovery offer uses existing browser timestamp/baseline-unchanged explanation and restore/copy/discard; no copy textarea before copy action. Body inert and editable false while recovered; restore only adopts local editor draft, not a save success.

Read-only canEdit=false forces preview and disables design while Markdown source/reading/PNG remain view modes; shown generic message is valid when capability false with no issues suffix (e.g. publication guard). Actual source-unavailable/conflict issue codes must be retained as dynamic message suffix for those mapped variants, not erased.

Missing preview gives exact preserve-original copy and no replacement empty canvas/start action. Real privileged owner API/resource guard remains distinct from anonymous public projection; no runtime successful recovery/save asserted.

styleFindings.finding: Raster texture/shading and approximate geometry remain illustrative. Use shared flat CSS tokens and source conditional scrolling/focus/disabled behavior; no exact CSS or responsive/runtime compliance claimed.

limitations: Static design review does not prove API execution, permissions, dirty/busy/close guards, focus/keyboard, persistence, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Only declared compatible state reviewed; hidden mutually exclusive branches remain separate mappings. Source-derived examples are not captured runtime results.
Per-image verdict does not complete full-design global consistency/coverage review or authorize product implementation.
